description: Peak resident memory (MiB) of the API's circuit preparation with preprocessing on (the pytket round-trip) for the bundled circuits whose peak exceeded 512 MiB in statevector or measured mode; every other bundled circuit peaked at 392 MiB or less. Each value is the larger of the two modes, measured in a fresh process that first imported the preparation worker's modules (about 110 MiB). peak_mib_at_least marks a preparation stopped at that size. services/preparation_limits.py refuses these circuits at submission when the value reaches the server's preparation memory limit.
measured: 2026-10-27, scripts/harness_bench/prep_peaks.py, pytket 1.33.0, Python 3.12, rosetta-api venv on an i9-13950HX host
